ui.chat.ask_attest.action.hint: Only a confirmed answer counts as your approval for deleting or moving files.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.answer_unconf: Your answer was sent without confirming, so changing it can't make it count as your approval. Ask the agent to ask again, then use Confirm and send.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.busy: The agent was busy and didn't take your answer. Confirm again in a moment.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.changed: This question changed or closed while you were confirming. Check it, then try again.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.expired: This question expired before you confirmed, so nothing was sent. It can't be answered any more.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.not_consent_b: Your answer was sent, but it wasn't confirmed as yours, so it won't count as your approval. Ask the agent to ask again, then use Confirm and send.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.not_eligible: To give your approval, answer in the terminal running this conversation. This copy of the app can't confirm answers, and an answer sent without confirming won't count as your approval.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.not_running: Open the conversation, then confirm again. It isn't running, so this answer couldn't be confirmed. An answer sent without confirming won't count as your approval.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.refused: Confirm again. The conversation didn't accept the confirmation, and an answer sent without confirming won't count as your approval.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.retry: The answer wasn't confirmed. Try again.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.secret: Answers with a hidden value can't be confirmed, because the confirmation can't show them. Use Send answer instead.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.sheet_open: Finish the confirmation that is already open.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.too_long: This answer is too long to show in full for confirmation. Shorten it, then confirm again.
ui.chat.ask_attest.refusal.window: Bring this window to the front, then confirm again.
ui.chat.ask_attest.sheet.consent_note: Confirming records this answer as given by you on this Mac, so the agent can treat it as your consent.
